paragraphs: R' Yehudah, son of R' Yaakov.
Mentioned in Zohar Chadash, Bereshit, on the verse “Let the earth bring forth.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The verse-fragment label תוצא הארץ is retained without an invented verse number or named-edition claim; earlier Genesis 1:24/1:12 possibilities remain unverified suggestions.
בר׳ is read as son of R', preserving both abbreviated title components without authority or identity binding.
